verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.3 (-2.3% in a day) and momentum is 49: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,200. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-22T07:59:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,200 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,800 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,500 (1.27 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Rio Ferdinand and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Rio Ferdinand 89 Base Icon -41.0%; Lilian Thuram 89 Base Icon -36.8%; Aurélien Tchouaméni 84 Rare -33.3%; Eusébio 91 Base Icon -31.2%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: 3x 79+ Upgrade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 6.7K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
